title: Notification devices.
officialText:
Visual notification devices shall be provided to alert room occupants of incoming telephone calls
and a door knock or bell. Notification devices shall not be connected to visual alarm signal appliances. Permanently installed
telephones shall have volume controls and an electrical outlet complying with ICC A117.1, including Section 309 (Operable
Parts), located within 48 inches (1219 mm) of the telephone to facilitate the use of a TTY.
